master_request: Create ONE isolated mature small orchard tree game sprite, with NO FRUIT, on true transparent background. Same gently elevated three-quarter top-down game camera as garden and furniture. No realistic rendering, no smooth vector circles, no shiny 3D, no black heavy cartoon stroke, no grass tile or landscape, no flowerpot, no letters. Single compact rounded orchard tree with a short sturdy trunk and two visible branch forks. Broad canopy with 5-7 rounded lobes, small clusters rather than individual noisy leaves. Entire tree fits within a square canvas, crown centered horizontally, roots bottom-center at about 94% image height, object occupies ~86% of canvas height and ~78% width. Short faint contact shadow only under roots. This is the master design for matching apple, peach, and young variants; silhouette must read well at 120px. Deliver a single standalone sprite, no sheet, no labels.
